name: Executor Arren
summary: At Deathknell, Executor Arren directs the settlement's defense as new undead rise from their graves. He leads efforts against Scourge zombies, wild beasts, and threats to the Forsaken.

sections.title: Commander of Deathknell
sections.body: Executor Arren directs Deathknell's defense from outside its chapel. While caretakers in the crypts guide newly risen undead through their confusion, Arren turns their attention to survival beyond the graves. Under Queen Sylvanas Windrunner's banner, he organizes efforts to clear mindless zombies from the village borders. The Forsaken secure ground here in the shadow of Lordaeron's fall.

sections.title: Securing the Borderlands
sections.body: Danger surrounds Deathknell beyond the confused newly risen. Under Arren's orders, scouts and initiates strike at the vicious spiders in Night Web's Hollow and hunt predators along the woodland edges. He calls on every capable hand to act, testing whether new arrivals can defend their second chance and serve the Dark Lady.

sections.title: The Crimson Threat
sections.body: The Scarlet Crusade is Arren's greatest concern. Its zealots seek to destroy all undead and make no distinction between the Scourge and the free-willed Forsaken. Arren orders strikes against Scarlet patrols encamped in the Tirisfal wilderness. His forces intercept couriers and study stolen dispatches to protect Deathknell from a purge in holy fire.

faq.answer: Executor Arren commands Deathknell's defense in Tirisfal Glades. He organizes newly risen Forsaken to defend the village and secure the surrounding countryside.

faq.q: What rank is an Executor among the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Among the Forsaken, Executors are trusted military and administrative commanders. They govern local garrisons, direct field operations, and enforce Queen Sylvanas Windrunner's will and law.

faq.q: Why does Arren send recruits against the zombies?
faq.answer: Mindless Scourge remnants prowl near Deathknell, left behind after the plague devastated Lordaeron. Arren orders them cleared so they cannot tear apart newly awakened undead as they leave the crypts.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade is a radical human faction devoted to exterminating all undead. It holds outposts across Lordaeron's ruins and seeks to purge the Forsaken, whom it considers no different from the Scourge.
Night Web's Hollow is a gold mine northwest of Deathknell, overrun by spiders. The Forsaken need its gold, so Arren sends recruits to clear out the arachnids a little at a time.

faq.q: Where does Arren send recruits once they finish his tasks?
faq.answer: After Deathknell's immediate threats are dealt with, Arren sends capable recruits to Brill to report to Executor Zygand and aid the wider Forsaken effort across Tirisfal Glades.

angles.text: As an undead, you meet Executor Arren among the first commanders in Tirisfal. He gives you an early taste of duty under the Dark Lady.
As a member of the Horde, you see Arren's commands at Deathknell secure its first foothold in northern Lordaeron amid hostile surroundings.
